name: Heleisih de Jyuedouchang III
source: Aureti was sold to the darkest streets of the capital city of Helres, where her master was the infamous slave trader known as Guloss, the Black Street King. The notoriously cruel Guloss was a terrifying man - lustful, ill-tempered, and mercilessly brutal, never valuing a slave's life.
